title: TENSION ORGAN
description: A hand-tuned elastic membrane whose cells exchange stress through structural and diagonal constraints. The autonomous drive moves through the material itself; grabbing a node directly deforms the whole surface and leaves residual energy behind.

visual_finish.composition: a suspended asymmetric membrane spanning the full field with tension concentrated away from the centre
visual_finish.material_model: translucent woven foil with stress-dependent colour, edge light and fine structural threads
